records.title: Read bids through a direct request
records.detail: OutLayer refused the caller's access to the evaluator's secret row. The guest did not run.

records.title: Change the published rubric
records.detail: The deployed contract exports no rubric setter.

records.title: Close before the deadline
records.detail: The open tender stayed open before its published deadline.

records.title: Copy a sealed bid
records.detail: An identical ciphertext submitted from another account was refused before evaluation.

records.title: Deliver a fake evaluation
records.detail: The callback refuses external callers before reading a result.

records.title: Evaluate a second time
records.detail: A second evaluation was refused after the accepted result. This method uses E_BAD_STATUS.

records.title: Award as an outsider
records.detail: The signer is outside the published committee.

records.title: Deviate without a rationale
records.detail: A real committee member tried to select an eligible bid below the first ranked bid with an empty rationale.

records.title: Accept and redirect another bidder's award
records.detail: The attacker requested a transfer to their own account. Only the awarded bidder may accept.

records.title: Inject instructions into a proposal
records.detail: Vendor C's published example was flagged. Its actual total was 5200 basis points, rank 2 of 3. A flag does not prove that every model resisted the text.
